title: We stopped gaminginit: what we know and what we don’t.
description: We stopped gaminginit in November 2026. Weekly players fell from 4,622 to 16 while we kept shipping, and we had no written stop line.
lede: Our process says every stop gets a write-up. This is the one for gaminginit: what the player numbers show, and the part where we never wrote down what would make us stop.
summary: Weekly players fell from 4,622 to 16 while the changelog kept growing. The lesson is about the stop line we never wrote down.
